name: std::feclearexcept
intro: Attempts to clear the floating-point exceptions that are listed in the bitmask argument excepts, which is a bitwise OR of the floating point exception macros.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
excepts

 -

  bitmask listing the exception flags to clear

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: 0 if all indicated exceptions were successfully cleared or if excepts is zero. Returns a non-zero value on error.

examples.output:
1.0/0.0 = inf
division by zero reported
1.0/10 = 0.1
inexact result reported
sqrt(-1) = -nan
invalid result reported
